environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) running Amazon Linux 2, behind a Network Load Balancer (NLB) with TCP passthrough on port 443. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No application-layer inspection. Flask app served via gunicorn with 4 workers. SQLite database on local EBS volume. Instance profile has no special permissions. CloudWatch agent collects only system metrics (CPU, memory, disk).

config.load_balancer: NLB with TCP listener (no HTTP inspection)
config.database: SQLite on local EBS gp3 volume
